item.title: Ex-Anthropic researcher warns AI could grow "smart enough to kill us"
item.description: The development of AI "doesn't look that different from say, 'Terminator,' or from science fiction films," Jacob Coxon said.

item.title: Iran strikes U.S. jets after Trump promises war to end after midterms
item.description: U.S. jets were hit by Iranian missiles while parked at a base in Jordan, sources tell CBS News, while Trump said the war will end "immediately" after midterms.

item.title: Extended Interview: Ex-Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, who warns AI could destroy humanity
item.description: Jacob Coxon publicly resigned from his position as an Anthropic researcher on Tuesday, accusing the company and rival developer and ChatGPT-maker OpenAI of "gambling with our lives" by racing to develop advanced AI models. He spoke with Jo Ling Kent about his decision to resign and why he feels AI could one day threaten humanity.

item.title: Family's 9/11 loss inspires a school that's helped hundreds of kids
item.description: CBS News producer Caroline Lewis shares the story of her mother Patty, who established a school in a disadvantaged community after losing her husband on 9/11.

item.title: Rams and 49ers to face off in first-ever regular season NFL game in Australia
item.description: The NFL's first-ever regular season game in Australia is about to kick off, with the Los Angeles Rams set to play the San Francisco 49ers. A halftime performance by Joe Jonas is also expected. Network 10 reporter Steph Baumgartel joins "The Daily Report" to share the excitement.

item.title: GOP Rep. Rob Bresnahan campaigns on data center limits while investing in industry
item.description: According to a financial disclosure, the Pennsylvania lawmaker holds investments in companies positioned to benefit from the data center industry's continued growth.

item.title: Scientists still identifying 9/11 victims' remains | 60 Minutes Archives
item.description: It's been 25 years since 9/11, and the New York City Office of Chief Medical Examiner continues its pledge to identify remains for as long as there are families looking for answers.

item.title: Republican congressional candidate explains why he chose to attend GOP midterm convention
item.description: Republican congressional candidate Michael Bouchard Jr., who is attending the GOP midterm convention, joins "The Daily Report" to share his thoughts on the Iran war, Trump's promised $5,000 payments, and more.

item.title: Law professor breaks down Supreme Court's decision to block Missouri's new congressional map
item.description: The Supreme Court has blocked Missouri's use of a new congressional map that would have favored Republicans ahead of the midterms. CBS News legal contributor Jessica Levinson explains what this means.

item.title: Trump says he'll return to Texas to campaign for Paxton ahead of midterms
item.description: CBS News Texas had an exclusive interview with President Trump on Thursday, ahead of his second appearance at the Republican midterm convention. Political reporter Jack Fink unpacks his conversation with Mr. Trump. Then, CBS News correspondent Jason Allen has more on protests outside the venue.

item.title: Woman widowed by 9/11 co-founds school to keep her husband's memory alive
item.description: Sept. 11, 2001, was a day of sadness and tragedy for many families, like that of CBS News producer Caroline Lewis. She shares the story of her mom's school, which became a living tribute to those we lost.

item.title: Joe diGenova resigns from DOJ after overseeing "grand conspiracy" probe
item.description: Joe diGenova, the prosecutor who was tapped by Attorney General Todd Blanche to supervise the "grand conspiracy" investigation targeting Obama- and Biden-era officials, told CBS News he has resigned.

item.title: Dolly Parton's sister describes Dolly's marriage with Carl: "He adored her"
item.description: Dolly Parton's younger sister sat down with Gayle King for a conversation that included Dolly's makeup routine and her decades-long love affair with her husband Carl.

item.title: Why you shouldn't bank on Trump's $5,000 dividends happening
item.description: President Trump pledged $5,000 to all American adults if Republicans retain control of Congress. You may not be able to take that to the bank.

item.title: Trump's $5,000 payments would reignite inflation, economists say
item.description: Mr. Trump's pledge to give $5,000 to Americans would stoke inflation and worsen the nation's fiscal outlook, according to economists.

item.title: Lawsuit seeks to block deployment of ICE, federal agents to polling sites
item.description: A coalition of advocacy groups and a Democratic-led city filed a preemptive lawsuit seeking to block the Trump administration from deploying armed ICE agents to polling sites ahead of the midterm elections.

item.title: Why Trump's promised $5,000 payments to Americans are unlikely to happen
item.description: Vice President JD Vance has doubled down on President Trump's pledge to make $5,000 payments to all adult Americans if Republicans win the midterm elections, saying the money will come from tariffs. CBS News' Kathryn Watson breaks down why the pledge is dubious.

item.title: Former FBI special agent details hunt for alleged 9/11 mastermind
item.description: "Daughters of 9/11," a new documentary airing on CBS on Friday, follows two women who lost their fathers in the attacks and are demanding alleged mastermind Khalid Sheikh Mohammed be held accountable. Their journey leads them to Retired FBI Special Agent Frank Pellegrino, who spent more than a decade hunting for Mohammed and eventually questioned him. Pellegrino joins "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Trump and Vance to speak at final night of first GOP midterm convention
item.description: President Trump is set to speak at the GOP's first midterm convention again on Thursday, following remarks from Vice President JD Vance. CBS News' Ed O'Keefe reports.

item.title: Ohio Sen. Jon Husted calls GOP midterm convention an opportunity "to explain what we've been doing"
item.description: Ohio Republican Sen. Jon Husted, who is facing off against former Democratic Sen. Sherrod Brown, chose to address his party's midterm convention in Dallas unlike some candidates who chose to stay in their home states. Husted joins "The Takeout" to discuss his campaign and more.

item.title: Sen. Shaheen's daughter says "time is up on the Trump administration" after winning House primary
item.description: While New Hampshire Democratic Sen. Jeanne Shaheen is not seeking reelection, her daughter is hoping she can carry the torch forward after prevailing Tuesday night in the Democratic primary for the state's First Congressional District. Stefany Shaheen joins "The Takeout" to unpack her win and discuss what comes next.

item.title: 9/10: CBS Evening News
item.description: Trump shares details on $5,000 dividend; Fourth Delta flight makes emergency landing.

item.title: RNC chair says "we need the president to be on the ballot" as midterms loom
item.description: Thursday marks Day 2 of the GOP's first midterm convention. Republican National Committee Chairman Joe Gruters joins "The Takeout" from the convention floor to discuss his party's game plan for the November elections.

item.title: Steve Scalise says details of $5,000 dividends would "obviously have to be worked out by Congress"
item.description: At the GOP midterm convention on Wednesday night, President Trump said the federal government would give every American adult $5,000 if Republicans stay in power after the midterms. CBS News senior White House and political correspondent Ed O'Keefe reports from the convention floor.

item.title: Diesel prices are nearing $6 a gallon for the first time ever
item.description: The price of diesel has soared more than 60% over the last year, a surge energy experts said is likely to continue. Here's why.

item.title: Trump shares more details on $5,000 dividends in exclusive interview
item.description: CBS News Texas political reporter Jack Fink spoke with President Trump for an exclusive interview during the president's visit to North Texas.

item.title: George W. Bush says Americans "don't pay attention to the lesson of 9/11"
item.description: Former President George W. Bush gave rare remarks on Wednesday as Americans mark 25 years since the Sept. 11 terrorist attacks.

item.title: Daughters of 9/11 victims seek answers about accused mastermind's trial
item.description: A new documentary, "Daughters of 9/11," follows their pursuit of information and closure, which they were determined to find for themselves, other families who lost loved ones in the attacks and the American public.

item.title: 9/11 widow establishes school in her late husband's honor
item.description: CBS Weekend News producer Caroline Lewis shares the story of her mother, who established a school serving an impoverished community in honor of her late husband, Adam Lewis, a KBW banker who was killed on 9/11.

item.title: The 60 Minutes Channel
item.description: 60 Minutes has been the #1 News show in America for 50 straight years. Watch the biggest interviews and most important stories.
